title_en: Archives Lexicon — for readers who want the map
title_fr: Lexique Archives — pour ceux qui veulent la carte
intro_en: The novella stands alone without this page. These entries name the physics already in the prose — Fermi quiet, Filter talk, saccades, aperiodic structure. We do not preach Dark Forest as gospel; we show a quieter, colder engine.
intro_fr: La novella se tient sans cette page. Ces entrées nomment la physique déjà dans la prose — ciel de Fermi, Filtre, saccades, pavages apériodiques.

entries.title: Saccadic masking / Displaced Gaze
entries.body: On Earth, the brain edits out the blur between eye-jumps so consciousness feels continuous. In the Mark-IV, the jump between Slot and camera nodule is not edited — you feel the cut. Displaced Gaze is the Stray technique of parking the 'I' in a CRT nodule. The interactive page of that name lets you feel Chapter 01 (The Third Millimeter).

entries.title: Sealed iron · then honest light
entries.body: Nailer’s Mark-IV was sealed iron: 3mm Slot, camera nodules, Faraday mesh welded shut. Later, under the same corporation, Ashen-Null contractors board with fiber tethers and a flashlight they treat as the only honest light — Maglite as signature, Chrono as a second you can hold still. Same emission philosophy. Different war. Different eye.

entries.title: Aperiodic tiling / copper braid / cyst etch
entries.body: The Malachite braids and cyst ridges fill space with local matching rules that never settle into a repeating wallpaper motif — cousin to Penrose-like aperiodicity. Non-ego work prefers coverage over signature. Signature is periodic; maintenance is not.

entries.title: Non-conscious threat (Archaeons / Cyst-Born)
entries.body: Not monsters with motives. Thermodynamic maintenance: high cognitive / EM noise as carcinogen; silence as restoration. They do not hate you. You are a thermal smudge on the glass. Hard-SF cousin to Blindsight’s non-conscious supremacy — our flavor is industrial Faraday horror, not vampire linguistics.

entries.title: Fermi quiet / Great Filter / Dark Forest (framed)
entries.body: Earth theorists named the empty sky many ways: Filter (something culls loud biospheres), Dark Forest (everyone hides and shoots). Vurtek doctrine flatters those stories into strategy. The novel’s physics is colder: local Signal Audit / Filtration as equation-balancing — incomplete, covered, reconstitutable. Not a finished cosmic end-state. Deck Zero’s Corpse-Sky creed is the later incomplete cousin: silence is a morgue, not mercy.

entries.title: Cognitive emission as lure
entries.body: Thought, radio, panic, poetry — structured entropy. Faraday weave and neuro-slurry are survival tools. Later contractors learn that honest light itself paints a signature. Same corporation. Different suit. Same sky.

entries.title: Form 99-C / amortized flesh
entries.body: Legal reclassification of injured humans into depreciable industrial assets. The emotional engine of the novella: love vs ledger. Accessible to any reader who has ever owed something that grew teeth.

entries.title: Deck Zero (later work)
entries.body: Cairn-9. Warm hull. Maglite as honest light. Chrono as a second you can hold still. Not a sequel chapter of Nailer’s plot — same predator corp, same emission dread, different war. The novel stands alone. The dossier stands alone.
